name: dsh-release-guardian
description: Local, deterministic release-risk checks for DeepSeek Harness, Codex, and the command line.

interface.shortDescription: Audit release diffs for secrets, dangerous changes, and missing verification
interface.longDescription: Audit the current Git diff locally, discover project verification commands, and produce a deterministic release verdict. The bundled runner works without a separate global CLI installation. Scanning is read-only by default, sends no telemetry, and never publishes or deploys.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository and explain anything that blocks release.
Review my staged changes for release risks.
Discover this project's checks without running them.
